newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume slips, prices creep up.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume slips, prices creep up.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange shrank to 825 kilos on Wednesday from 1,692 on Tuesday, while dollar prices remained steady and lira prices rose as the lira eased against the dollar, dealers said.
Gold closed at $369.50 an ounce after $369.30 on Tuesday and at 1,274,000 lira per gram, against 1,270,250.
"There wasn't any real physical demand on the market today. More or less all the demand came from the banks buying gold to benefit from lira/dollar rates," one free market dealer said.
The lira eased against the dollar to 107,260 from Tuesday's 106,740 close, but firmed from a day's low of 107,400 on the central bank intervention to support the lira.
Volume was 185 kilos in the morning session when no dollar deals were made and 640 kilos in the afternoon. 64.9 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms.
